message.content: {"claims":[{"text":"Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain adequate oxygenation, reassessing ABG after the recent arterial pO2 84 mmHg on FiO2 80% and PEEP 10-12 cmH2O.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"mechanical ventilation and oxygenation"},{"text":"Maintain and titrate vasopressor support (norepinephrine infusion) with frequent hemodynamic monitoring given recent hypotension (NIBP 81/37, mean 49).","action_type":"monitored","target":"hemodynamic status and vasopressor support"},{"text":"Obtain repeat complete blood count with differential and coagulation studies to track the falling platelet count (107 to 49 K/uL) and leukocytosis with circulating blasts.","action_type":"specimen_collected","target":"blood counts and coagulation panel"},{"text":"Assess and manage cytopenias and risk of bleeding, including transfusion thresholds for hemoglobin 9.3 g/dL and platelets 49 K/uL, and monitor for bleeding.","action_type":"assessment_performed","target":"cytopenias and bleeding risk"},{"text":"Continue disease-directed therapy for the underlying hematologic malignancy (hydroxyurea, fludarabine/cytarabine-based regimen, tamoxifen) per oncology plan with tumor lysis monitoring.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"hematologic malignancy treatment"},{"text":"Monitor for tumor lysis syndrome with serial electrolytes, uric acid, phosphate, calcium, creatinine, and LDH, and maintain adequate hydration/urine output.","action_type":"monitored","target":"tumor lysis and renal/electrolyte status"},{"text":"Continue antimicrobial therapy (cefepime, vancomycin, voriconazole, acyclovir, TMP-SMX) and reassess for infection given neutropenia and critical illness.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"antimicrobial prophylaxis/treatment"},{"text":"Correct electrolyte abnormalities, including hypokalemia (3.4 mEq/L), hypocalcemia (total 7.9 mg/dL, ionized 1.09 mmol/L), and hyponatremia (129 mEq/L), with repeat labs.","action_type":"ordered","target":"electrolyte repletion and monitoring"},{"text":"Maintain sedation/analgesia per protocol (propofol and fentanyl infusions, PCA hydromorphone) with daily sedation interruption assessment and delirium monitoring.","action_type":"monitored","target":"sedation and analgesia"},{"text":"Provide supportive ICU care including VTE prophylaxis consideration, glycemic control for glucose 251 mg/dL, and nutrition via existing feeding tube.","action_type":"ordered","target":"supportive ICU care"}]}

{"claims":[{"text":"Continue norepinephrine infusion and titrate to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure, given current MAP 68-89 mmHg on vasopressor.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"norepinephrine infusion"},{"text":"Treat severe metabolic acidosis (bicarbonate 8-9 mEq/L, anion gap 18-22, lactate rising to 7.2 mmol/L) with sodium bicarbonate and reassess acid-base status.","action_type":"treatment_performed","target":"metabolic acidosis"},{"text":"Recheck arterial blood gas and lactate serially to monitor worsening lactic acidosis.","action_type":"monitored","target":"arterial blood gas and lactate"},{"text":"Continue potassium chloride replacement for hypokalemia (K 3.0-3.1 mEq/L) and recheck potassium.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"potassium replacement"},{"text":"Continue magnesium sulfate replacement for hypomagnesemia (1.2 mg/dL) and recheck magnesium.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"magnesium replacement"},{"text":"Continue calcium gluconate replacement for hypocalcemia (ionized calcium 1.09-1.15 mmol/L, total calcium 6.4-6.8 mg/dL) and recheck ionized calcium.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"calcium replacement"},{"text":"Manage hyperglycemia (glucose 253-332 mg/dL) with insulin therapy and frequent glucose monitoring.","action_type":"treatment_performed","target":"hyperglycemia"},{"text":"Monitor renal function and urine output for acute kidney injury (creatinine 1.9-2.0 mg/dL, BUN 37-41 mg/dL).","action_type":"monitored","target":"renal function"},{"text":"Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (cefepime, metronidazole) and monitor for sepsis given leukocytosis and lactic acidosis.","action_type":"therapy_continued","target":"antibiotic therapy"},{"text":"Maintain fall precautions and bed rest given high fall risk and bedfast mobility status.","action_type":"monitored","target":"fall precautions"}]}
